hinge-input.label: Hinge as input
hinge-input.description: Folding changes gameplay, sound, an effect or an action. A layout that merely resizes is not enough.

posture-layout.label: Pose-aware layout
posture-layout.description: A documented arrangement for laptop, book, tent, seated or other physical poses.

cover-display.label: Cover-screen experience
cover-display.description: A documented role or continuity on the outer screen. This does not imply simultaneous use of both displays.

expanded-layout.label: Expanded workspace
expanded-layout.description: A documented larger canvas, multi-pane layout or additional space when open.

split-view.label: Split View and multiple windows
split-view.description: Explicit support for system multitasking or multiple app windows. Two panels inside one app do not qualify.

support-only.label: Duo support documented
support-only.description: The source confirms Duo support, but our record does not substantiate a more specific interaction. This is an evidence limit, not a claim that the app lacks features.
